title: Microtubules / Tubulin / Body-Mind-Spirit — Recovery, Physics Audit and Cross-Scale Research Contract
status: primary project prompt + Great Book neuroscience/quantum-consciousness archaeology + external scientific audit + archive-generated multiscale formalization
scientific_abstract: Microtubules provide one of the archive's clearest examples of why cross-scale integration requires more than placing equations from different disciplines beside each other. Their established biological roles include cytoskeletal structure, neuronal polarity, intracellular transport and regulated lattice dynamics. The Great Book and later project prompts additionally explore quantum, synchronization and Spirit/Axis interpretations. The scientifically substantive bridge is therefore not the word 'quantum' but a multiscale map: microscopic tubulin/microtubule states must be transformed into mesoscopic neuronal variables and then into network observables through an explicit channel C_micro->neural. This paper introduces a cross-scale consistency error epsilon_C(t)=||C(Phi_micro^t(X))-Phi_neural^t(C(X))||. A proposed microtubule mechanism becomes explanatory only if it predicts neural evolution within a quantified error regime and outperforms a simpler classical/neural baseline. Quantum variants additionally require a Hamiltonian, environmental/decoherence model, operational coherence or entanglement witness and timescale. This framework preserves the project's microtubule research interest while separating established cell biology, classical collective modes, speculative quantum models and theological interpretation.
importance: The user's remembered 'tubals/microtubals' strand is real and substantial. Microtubules appear both in the 2024 Great Book's Body-Mind-Spirit/Human Map model and later explicit user prompts tying tubulars/microtubules to Spiral, Tree of Strife, advanced/retarded waves and the Axis. The later 11D transcript then over-literalized some of those links into unsupported claims of social-action-induced quantum entanglement.

facts: Microtubules are polymers built from alpha/beta-tubulin heterodimers and are major components of the eukaryotic cytoskeleton.
In neurons they help establish polarity, provide tracks for intracellular transport, participate in axon/dendrite development and remodeling, and interact with many microtubule-associated proteins.
Tubulin post-translational modifications and lattice properties form a biologically meaningful tubulin code affecting stability, trafficking and cellular function.

quantum_consciousness_status.orch_or: Penrose-Hameroff Orch OR proposes cognitively relevant quantum processing in neuronal microtubules; it remains controversial rather than established neuroscience.
quantum_consciousness_status.decoherence_debate: Tegmark-style estimates argued extremely rapid decoherence; Hagan/Hameroff/Tuszynski challenged the modeled assumptions and obtained longer estimates. The disagreement does not itself establish Orch OR.
quantum_consciousness_status.2026_status: Recent papers continue to propose microtubule quantum-consciousness mechanisms, while critical reviews emphasize that operational demonstrations of neural entanglement, long-lived coherence and uniquely quantum explanatory necessity remain insufficient/contested.

cross_scale_contract.composition: C_micro_to_network=C_neural_to_network o C_micro_to_neural when interfaces/types are compatible
cross_scale_contract.meaning: If microscopic dynamics really underwrite a neural effective model, evolve-then-coarse-grain and coarse-grain-then-evolve should agree within a stated approximation regime.
cross_scale_contract.measurement: Define the norm/metric, temporal window and acceptable epsilon_C before interpreting agreement.
cross_scale_contract.failure: Large or undefined epsilon_C means the micro mechanism has not yet been shown to explain the neural model, even if both descriptions are individually meaningful.

quantum_branch_contract.coherence_example: For selected basis states i,j, monitor |rho_ij(t)| with a declared basis and operational preparation/readout; coherence in one basis is not automatically computation or cognition.
quantum_branch_contract.entanglement_requirement: If entanglement is claimed, specify subsystems and an operational entanglement witness/measure appropriate to the state class; generic molecular quantum behavior is insufficient.
quantum_branch_contract.decoherence_timescale: A claimed functional effect requires relevant quantum information to persist and couple onward on timescales compatible with the proposed biological operation.
quantum_branch_contract.baseline: Classical stochastic/mechanical/electrophysiological microtubule and neuronal models must be compared before asserting uniquely quantum explanatory necessity.

causal_model_ladder.level_0: correlation: microtubule variable and neural/behavioral variable covary
causal_model_ladder.level_1: intervention: perturbing the microtubule variable changes a neural variable under controlled conditions
causal_model_ladder.level_2: mechanism: a quantitative C_micro_to_neural predicts the direction/magnitude/timescale of the effect
causal_model_ladder.level_3: quantum necessity: a quantum model predicts data that suitable classical models cannot explain comparably
causal_model_ladder.rule: Do not jump from molecular importance to quantum necessity or from quantum effect to consciousness without passing intermediate causal levels.

hard_boundaries: Logging onto a website, eating from a symbolic Tree of Strife, moral choices or social fixation are not known to induce quantum entanglement of neural microtubules.
Quantum entanglement does not permit ordinary controllable faster-than-light communication or prove telepathy.
Room-temperature molecular quantum effects can exist without implying a quantum computer or a quantum theory of consciousness.
Microtubules are biologically important even if quantum-consciousness hypotheses fail; the classical cytoskeletal/transport/plasticity branch remains independent.
conclusions: Microtubules are a scientifically substantive project node because their biological importance is real; their relevance does not depend on a quantum-consciousness claim succeeding.
The largest conceptual gap is the cross-scale map from microtubule state to neuronal/network state. The new epsilon_C consistency condition makes that gap explicit and measurable in principle.
Quantum models should be evaluated as competing mechanistic branches, not as prestige upgrades to classical biology.

A demonstrated molecular quantum effect would still be several inferential steps away from a theory of consciousness: persistence, controllability, neural coupling, behavioral relevance and quantum necessity each require evidence.

Within the Potatoverse, Door/Axis language can continue to organize the symbolic interpretation, but the scientific paper should make its strongest claims at the level of biological mechanism and measurable cross-scale prediction.
